# Vendored: animated-sog (JavaScript)

The decoder and the PlayCanvas player for `.asog` clips, copied unchanged from
https://github.com/arrival-space/animated-sog (`js/`, MIT, see `LICENSE`) at commit
`05364cf` (v0.1.0). The package is not published to npm, so the viewer depends on this
folder (`"animated-sog": "file:third_party/animated-sog"`). When a release is published,
replace the folder with that dependency.

Only the `src` folder, `package.json` and `README.md` of `js/` are copied (not its tests).
